nl: dns query count anomalies by source ip
generated_kql:
imDns
| make-series QueryCount = count() on TimeGenerated from ago(14d) to now() step 1d by SrcIpAddr
| extend (AnomalyFlag, AnomalyScore, Baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(QueryCount, 1.5)
| mv-expand TimeGenerated, QueryCount, AnomalyFlag, AnomalyScore, Baseline
| where AnomalyFlag != 0
system_kql:
imDns
| make-series QueryCount = dcount(DnsQuery) on TimeGenerated from ago(14d) to now() step 1d by SrcIpAddr
| extend (AnomalyFlag, AnomalyScore, Baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(QueryCount, 1.5)
| mv-expand TimeGenerated, QueryCount, AnomalyFlag, AnomalyScore, Baseline
| where AnomalyFlag != 0
